title: Presto Verified Sites Registry
description: Curated list of origins recognized by the Presto maintainers. NOT a security guarantee — see VERIFIED_SITES.md. Editor documentation only: presto_core::verified_sites::list is the parser CI and the app enforce.

schemaVersion.description: Format version. Bump only on breaking format changes.

version.description: List version. Every change raises it by 1 to 100 over the newest signed record; a signed list never moves to a lower one.

items.description: Canonical origin: scheme://host[:port], lower case, no default port, no trailing slash, no path. ASCII only (Punycode A-labels for IDN). https or chrome-extension only: Firefox and Safari extension origins differ per profile.

displayName.description: Shown in the authorization popup. Printable ASCII without <, > or a backtick, no leading or trailing space.

description.description: Curator note, NOT shown in the popup. At most 200 bytes; no <, >, backtick, control, bidi or zero-width characters.

curatedBy.description: GitHub username of the curator who reviewed or added the entry.

addedAt.description: Calendar date the entry was added; audit trail only.
